title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Operations Rewards
summary: This document explains how to maximize rewards on the Business Gold Rewards Card by routing recurring operational expenses to eligible operations categories for 2.5% cash back, using up to 37 employee cards, and maintaining 1.0% earnings on non-operations purchases. It also covers controls to align vendor merchant category codes, centralizing billing for software/utilities, reviewing statements for returns/credits, and keeping documentation for high-value operations purchases.
faqs: How can I earn 2.5% on the Business Gold Rewards Card—what counts as “operations” categories?
What should I do if a vendor’s merchant category code appears misclassified for operations rewards?
How many employee cards can I issue to capture decentralized operational spend (and how do controls help)?
If an expense is not operations-coded, how much cash back will I still earn?
How should I handle non-operations/discretionary spending to keep audit visibility?
